import pytest
from string_utils.manipulation import prettify
from string_utils.errors import InvalidInputError

def test_prettify_basic_example():
    """Test the prettification of a complex string with multiple formatting rules."""
    raw = ' unprettified string ,, like this one,will be"prettified" .it\\' s awesome! '
    expected = "Unprettified string, like this one, will be \"prettified\". It's awesome!"
    assert prettify(raw) == expected

def test_prettify_percent_and_saxon_genitive():
    """Test that percentages are not preceded by a space and that Saxon genitive is fixed."""
    raw = "I have 100 % of the cake and Dave' s dog."
    expected = "I have 100% of the cake and Dave's dog."
    assert prettify(raw) == expected

def test_prettify_invalid_input_raises_error():
    """Test that passing a non-string raises InvalidInputError."""
    with pytest.raises(InvalidInputError):
        prettify(123)  # non-string input
